notes: Seed URL works over https. No Clarity site (elections.json 404). The Elections Administrator page posts Hart-style Cumulative and Precinct Results Reports for each election. 2024 general: the precinct-by-precinct file is a 35-page scan (header shading makes the run time illegible; header reads 'Unofficial Results' and 'OFFICAL ELECTION RESULTS') scanned and uploaded the morning of Nov 6. 2026 primary: unofficial Precinct Results Report with Election Day columns, Run Time 9:33 PM, uploaded 9:40 PM CST on election night. 2026 runoff: on election night only the cumulative county totals (Run Time 8:25 PM, uploaded 8:36 PM CDT); the precinct report was run 12:24 PM May 28 and uploaded 3:58 PM CDT May 28. Both runoff reports show 'Precincts Reporting 0 of 5' although they include Election Day votes (as printed). Rule 43 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-1): 2024_general LATER to UNDETERMINED. Rule 47 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-47): none. Targeted pass 3 2026-10-02 (targeted3-I): 2024_general stays UNDETERMINED: 'November General Cumulative Results 11052024.pdf' is a scan created 09:10 AM CST Nov 6 and uploaded 09:43 AM CST Nov 6; the preliminary reconciliation was uploaded Nov 14. No file for 2024 has an election-night printed or upload time. Wayback harvest had no captures in any window; no sweep file; no check 4 source found.
